title.en: Before you speak: the three elements of presentation style
title.id: Sebelum kamu bicara: tiga unsur gaya presentasi

sources: Written for this lesson from its own objectives and reading: the three elements of presentation style, grounding yourself before you speak, and adjusting to the room. These are standard practices of workplace communication, taught here in the lesson's own words. The case and the character are invented for this film and appear in no other course. No third-party script, footage, picture or sound.

sub.en: The three elements of presentation style

keys.en: The room reads her body *before her words*.

say.en: Tika knows her material. But she walks in looking at the floor, and her hands will not stay still.
say.id: Tika menguasai materinya. Tapi ia masuk sambil menatap lantai, dan tangannya tak bisa diam.

say.en: The audience reads your body before it hears your words. If the two disagree, the body wins.
say.id: Audiens membaca tubuhmu sebelum mendengar kata-katamu. Jika keduanya bertentangan, tubuh yang menang.

p.en: *What they see*: posture, eye contact, gestures that belong to the sentence.
p.id: *Yang mereka lihat*: postur, kontak mata, gerak tangan yang selaras dengan kalimat.

p.en: *What they hear* under the words: pitch, pace, volume.
p.id: *Yang mereka dengar* di balik kata: nada, tempo, volume.

p.en: *What they feel*: you read the room and respond to it.
p.id: *Yang mereka rasakan*: kamu membaca ruangan dan menanggapinya.

say.en: Vocal emphasis: what they hear under the words.
say.id: Penekanan suara: yang mereka dengar di balik kata-kata.

say.en: And emotional connection: what they feel when you read the room and respond.
say.id: Dan koneksi emosional: yang mereka rasakan saat kamu membaca ruangan dan menanggapinya.

foot.en: All of it *before* you walk in.

p.en: Both flat on the floor, weight even.
Three slow breaths, longer out than in.
p.id: Tiga napas pelan, embusan lebih panjang.

say.en: Presence is prepared, not performed. Before she walks in next time, Tika does three things. Feet flat on the floor.
say.id: Kehadiran itu disiapkan, bukan dipertontonkan. Sebelum masuk lagi, Tika melakukan tiga hal. Kaki menapak rata di lantai.

say.en: Three slow breaths, longer out than in.
say.id: Tiga napas pelan, dengan embusan yang lebih panjang.

say.en: And a home for her hands, so no part of her mind has to watch them.
say.id: Dan tempat istirahat untuk tangannya, supaya pikirannya tak perlu lagi mengawasinya.

say.en: All of it before she walks in, like an athlete warming up.
say.id: Semuanya sebelum ia masuk, seperti atlet yang melakukan pemanasan.

kicker.en: Match the style to the room

p.en: Mark the answer with your voice.

p.id: Gerak lebih lebar. Jeda yang nyata.

p.en: Look at the lens. Add energy.

say.en: The same elements change with the room. One to one: stillness, eye contact, a slower pace.
say.id: Unsur yang sama berubah mengikuti ruangannya. Empat mata: tenang, kontak mata, tempo lebih pelan.

say.en: A small meeting: sit forward, and use your voice to mark the answer.
say.id: Rapat kecil: duduk condong ke depan, dan pakai suaramu untuk menandai jawaban.

say.en: A large room: wider gestures, a slower pace, real pauses.
say.id: Ruangan besar: gerak lebih lebar, tempo lebih pelan, jeda yang nyata.

say.en: A video call: the camera flattens you, so look at the lens and add energy.
say.id: Panggilan video: kamera membuatmu tampak datar, maka tatap lensanya dan tambah energi.

say.en: The next presentation has the same material. This time her body says what her words say.
say.id: Presentasi berikutnya memakai materi yang sama. Kali ini tubuhnya mengatakan hal yang sama dengan kata-katanya.

say.en: She did not copy anyone. She adjusted the elements, not her personality.
say.id: Ia tidak meniru siapa pun. Ia menyesuaikan unsurnya, bukan kepribadiannya.

turn.en: Before your next meeting: feet, three breaths, a home for your hands.
turn.id: Sebelum rapatmu berikutnya: kaki, tiga napas, tempat untuk tangan.

say.en: Now it is your turn. Before your next meeting: feet, three breaths, a home for your hands.
say.id: Sekarang giliranmu. Sebelum rapatmu berikutnya: kaki, tiga napas, tempat untuk tangan.
